adjudicated_findings.claim: nested negative zero is normalized to zero inside object/array JSON
adjudicated_findings.repair: Preserve integer lexical tokens during generic JSON parsing and reject nested -0 before canonicalization; add object and array negative-zero tests.

adjudicated_findings.claim: SPM part 4 supplied by packet builder is truncated
adjudicated_findings.basis: The GitHub-built artifact contains complete part 4 with the END marker; all four payloads concatenate exactly to the frozen SPM SHA-256.
All three files are present in GitHub artifact 10851057882 and its manifest.

adjudicated_findings.claim: 36105362709 versus 36105497132 is an unresolved run identity discrepancy
adjudicated_findings.basis: 36105362709 is the mechanism-repair green run; 36105497132 is the subsequent exact marker-candidate green run and is the authoritative reviewed-candidate run. Construction evidence records both.

adjudicated_findings.repair: Reject symlink components/final artifacts and require resolved artifact parent to equal the resolved frozen schema directory before reading.

adjudicated_findings.claim: source-map comparison uses basenames rather than exact frozen full paths
adjudicated_findings.repair: Translate source-map artifact keys to exact frozen full paths and require set equality with SPM artifact paths.

adjudicated_findings.claim: artifact_id and sha256 shapes are not directly validated
adjudicated_findings.repair: Require non-empty artifact_id and lowercase 64-hex sha256 in direct SPM validation.

adjudicated_findings.claim: every source_ref_catalog entry must be referenced by an SPM entry
adjudicated_findings.basis: The exact frozen SPM intentionally contains catalog refs not used by entry rows (SRC-SPG-ENROLLMENT, SRC-SPG-STAGEB-VERIFY, SRC-V6). Catalog membership is not defined as entry-use closure; exact SPM hash remains authoritative.

adjudicated_findings.claim: workflow-trigger test omits the original Slice 1 preregistration path
adjudicated_findings.repair: Add the original preregistration path to trigger-coverage acceptance.

adjudicated_findings.claim: read-count test can miss symlink targets outside schema directory
adjudicated_findings.repair: Add explicit same-byte external symlink rejection test; symlink rejection makes the read-count blind spot non-authoritative.
